game.sourceRevisionScope: Baseline commit plus accepted working-tree changes; final build identity is the exact bundle and acceptance hashes below.
implementedFeatures: Twelve authored missions in four realms
Real tower defense and exclusive tower evolutions
Three equipped spells chosen from four real spells
Six functioning Home destinations: Story, Campaign, Heroes, Upgrades, Spells, Achievements
Responsive framed Boy/Girl selection with actual saved choice and combat stats
Twelve earned mission nodes and real mission briefing with editable three-slot spell loadout
Real Hero/Spells/Towers upgrades, costs, unlocks, purchase/equip/respec and saved state
Actual victory/defeat rewards and battle statistics; save-error exit protection
Responsive Settings/Achievements/Story and portrait phone layout support
knownLimits: No Items inventory or new item/XP economy
No physical-device installation or performance test
No public game deployment or public APK download authorized
Twelve earned campaign clears use accelerated simulation plus exact hashed saved-profile continuation, not a real-time hardware campaign
